morphology.pattern_note: 作为完整人名记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分。所列英语读音中 y 对应 /aɪ/，末音节为 /lə/；具体本人可能采用不同读音。

senses.zh_definition: 莱拉：通常用作女性名字；具体人物或其他专名须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A feminine given name, conventionally capitalized Lyla.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi perempuan yang lazimnya dieja Lyla dengan huruf awal besar.
senses.nuances: 这是专有名词解释，不是马来语普通词的官方释义。英语参考读音为 /ˈlaɪlə/，称呼具体人物时以本人读法为准。输入没有提供足以确定其词源或指称的语境。以下搭配为教学示例，未核实频率。姓名及读音参见 [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/lyla)。

etymology.historical_story: Lyla illustrates why personal names need more than a single attractive origin story. The name reference consulted identifies it either as a variant of Leila or as a feminine form of Lyle. These are different naming pathways. Without information from the bearer or family, a dictionary should preserve both possibilities rather than assign one definitive ancestral meaning. [Source](https://www.behindthename.com/name/lyla)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按所列英语读音记作 LYE-la，近似“莱拉”；记住这是姓名，实际读法先听本人。
